answer_1.quote: This work presents a large dataset to track examples of dog whistles in their various forms, and help train language models to do the same.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates outputs such as identifying dog whistle instances, disambiguating coded vs. non-coded word senses, and defining the covert meanings of dog whistles using LLMs.

answer_2.quote: Performance metrics from the Automatic Dog Whistle Detection experiments (Section 4.1) show that GPT-4 performed best on Dog Whistle Presence prediction in the zero-shot setting, and Gemini performed best on all other categories.

answer_4.quote: Leveraging the 100 test cases in the Synthetic-Detection dataset (Section 3.3), 62 Amazon Mechanical Turk workers were recruited to complete 720 unique annotations.
answer_4.guideline: Workers were expected to select dog whistle terms and definitions in isolation, from a set of 7 options (one of which was 'I am not sure / not present in options').
